title: ENACT-Heart -- ENsemble-based Assessment Using CNN and Transformer on Heart Sounds
abstract: arXiv:2502.16914v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: ENACT-Heart is a two-branch ensemble for heart-sound classification. A Vision Transformer (ViT) processes spectrogram images, while a convolutional neural network (CNN) processes visualizations of waveforms and spectral centroids derived from the same recordings. The branch predictions are combined by a weighted average with fixed, input-independent weights. On the PASCAL heart-sound dataset, the ensemble achieved an accuracy of 97.52%, compared with 93.88% for the ViT and 95.45% for the CNN. The ensemble achieved a macro-F1 of 0.94 and recall of 0.74 for extra heart sounds. On this dataset, late fusion improved accuracy and macro-F1 relative to both individual branches.

translated_title: ENACT-Heart——基于CNN与Transformer集成的心音评估方法
translated_abstract: ENACT-Heart是一个用于心音分类的双分支集成模型。视觉Transformer（ViT）处理频谱图图像，而卷积神经网络（CNN）处理由相同录音导出的波形及谱质心的可视化结果。两个分支的预测通过具有固定且与输入无关权重的加权平均进行融合。在PASCAL心音数据集上，该集成模型达到了97.52%的准确率，相比之下ViT的准确率为93.88%，CNN的准确率为95.45%。该集成模型取得了0.94的宏F1分数，以及对额外心音0.74的召回率。在该数据集上，后期融合相对于两个单独分支均提升了准确率和宏F1分数。
tldr: ENACT-Heart通过将处理频谱图的视觉Transformer与处理波形和谱质心可视化的CNN进行加权后期融合，在PASCAL心音数据集上实现了97.52%的分类准确率，优于任一单分支模型。
en_tdlr: ENACT-Heart is a two-branch ensemble that combines a ViT processing spectrograms with a CNN processing waveform and spectral-centroid visualizations via weighted late fusion, achieving 97.52% accuracy on the PASCAL heart-sound dataset and outperforming both individual branches.
